Pair by same physical Y; halves' grids drift (L period 191, R period 179, different origins). Right-page first entry spans grid rows 1-2 (y214-572) = 10.01.1836; twin row L4 (y935-1126) holds Josef Leopold + Joseph (08.04.1841). Giedel name cell SKIPPED: index says 'Grünewald geb. Strauß', birth-register surname ink ambiguous -> kept date cell only.
